name: exec
author: jm33-m0
comment: Run a shell command; process spawning is not opsec
help: Run one command on a Linux target and return combined stdout and stderr. mode=shell (default) runs through /bin/sh -c so redirection, pipes, and quoting work; mode=exec splits the command line into words and execs the program directly, creating no shell process. Process creation is visible in the process table, command line, auditd, and EDR. Prefer a module when one covers the task. Requires coffloader_linux.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: shell: run through /bin/sh -c; exec: split the command line and exec it directly without a shell
